predecessors.note: Vologases VI succeeded Vologases V c. 208 and was 'uncontested king of the Parthian Empire from 208 to 213'; the civil war with his brother Artabanus IV 'most likely started in c. 213'. The land is what he kept of the Parthian Empire.

land.text: Seleucia, the small principality of Vologases VI: he 'continued to rule Seleucia until 221/2' (Vologases VI page); 'would rule a small principality centered around Seleucia until 221/2' (Artabanus IV page)

successors.note: Neither page says who took Seleucia in 221/2. The only Parthian ruler left was his brother Artabanus IV (c. 213-224), who held 'most of the empire' from 216, and the Sasanians reached Mesopotamia only from 224, so the land is handed to the Parthian Empire (a reading, confidence 2). Vologases VI himself lasted to 228: the page's infobox has his death in 228, coin mints in his name 'appear in Mesopotamia until 228', and Ardashir I 'must have driven out or defeated Vologases in Mesopotamia soon after 228' (an inference on the page); no land is drawn after 222.

REPAIR 2026-10-19 (author, after review me-06-x): (1) Blocking finding, the Seleucia disc to 228: the Vologases VI page ('continued to rule Seleucia until 221/2') and the Artabanus IV page ('would rule a small principality centered around Seleucia until 221/2') were both re-read; they agree on 221/2 for Seleucia, and my first version credited the date to the Artabanus IV page alone and used the 228 of the infobox (death) and the coin mints. The dossier now ends in 222 (identity.end, the Seleucia keyframe, the capital, the certainty span, the dissolve) with counterpart parthian-empire (confidence 2: the pages do not say who took Seleucia). Vologases' coin mints 'in Mesopotamia until 228' and Ardashir driving him out 'soon after 228' (a page inference) are kept here only: the old war 'Ardashir I's conquest of Mesopotamia' (224-228, sasanian-empire against vologases-vi) was removed because it lay wholly after the state's end (rule 2); the sasanian-empire dossier (me-06-c) can carry it as a conquest of the Mesopotamian cities, and the page gives no land for it. I chose the dissolve in 222 over keeping the life to 228 with no land, because a state with no territory for six years would break rule 1/7. The renderer: nothing to draw for Vologases VI after 222; Seleucia is Parthian until 224 and Sasanian after (sasanian-empire /ledger/4). (2) ROUTE TO parthian-empire (me-06-a): 213 contest_start and 216 contest_end with counterpart vologases-vi (zone Media and Khuzestan; this dossier has them), a 213 loss of Seleucia to vologases-vi and a 222 gain back. (3) Thin item, the extent of the principality: the Seleucia page (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seleucia, opened) says nothing about Vologases VI or a principality, only that the city was 'completely destroyed by the Roman general Avidius Cassius in 165' and that the surrounding region 'might have supported half a million people'; the two pages above name only the city ('a small principality centered around Seleucia'), so the 60 km disc stays a placeholder.
